body:
Fixes #201

## Cause

The scheduled Dependencies audit on `main` at `2bbd35da` reported `lucide-react` and `vite` as outdated in both the JavaScript workbench manifest and its lockfile. The registries responded successfully. `taiki-e/install-action` v2.90.11 was released after that run and the next live audit reported its two workflow pins as well. [Scheduled audit log, lines 1061–1072](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/45843672479/job/139991965313)

## Changes

- Update the workbench to `lucide-react` 1.81.0 and `vite` 8.4.0 and regenerate `js/package-lock.json` with npm.
- Pin the Security and WASM uses of `taiki-e/install-action` to the commit tagged `v2.90.11`. [Upstream release](https://github.com/taiki-e/install-action/releases/tag/v2.90.11)
- Remove the PR setup `.gitkeep`. It failed the shared JavaScript layout test in all five initial PR workflows. [Initial JavaScript run, lines 858–861 of the full run log](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/45900520619)

[Case study](docs/case-studies/issue-201/README.md)

## Reproduce and verify

Run the audit from the repository root on the original PR commit `ad0b122a` and on this branch. It uses live registry data, so results can change as releases are published.

```sh
CHECK_DEPENDENCIES_MODE=enforce node .github/scripts/check-latest-dependencies.mjs
node --test --test-name-pattern='generated evidence stay out' js/test/repositoryLayout.test.mjs
```

The original commit reported six stale entries in the audit and failed the layout regression test. The fix passed the full audit of 184 declared versions and all tracked Cargo lockfiles. `npm ci --prefix js`, JavaScript lint and formatting, all 437 JavaScript tests, and the parity check passed locally. The installed React and WASM plugins resolve to Vite 8.4.0, and all nine Lucide icons imported by the workbench resolved.

`pre-commit` is unavailable in this environment. The applicable checks ran manually, including the JavaScript suite and lint, the tracked-file secrets scan, JSON and YAML parsing, and staged whitespace, end-of-file, conflict marker, and size checks. Git committed with its standard invocation.

All nine PR workflows passed on `4ca3248a`. The hosted enforcement audit checked 184 declared versions and all tracked Cargo lockfiles. The WebAssembly workflow passed its tests, coverage job, and React production build. [PR checks](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/pull/202/checks) · [Enforcement audit](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/45901060590/job/140186826368) · [WebAssembly workflow](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/45901060537)
title: Refresh dependencies flagged by the scheduled audit
